name: Bun mam
summary: Bun mam in Da Nang is rice noodles with boiled pork and a fermented-fish broth. It is pungent on purpose. The herbs and the pork fat are how you eat it.
origin: Fermented fish noodles are a southern habit that Da Nang cooks with boiled pork. This page is that city bowl.
howToEat: Smell the broth before you commit. If fermented fish is not for you, order a different noodle.
Toss the pork, herbs, and noodles through the broth so the bowl coats, then eat.
Come at lunch, when the pot has been going.
where: Bà Vân is on Trần Kế Xương. The page has the street and not a house number. Look for the sign and a busy room.
priceBand: A shop bowl is an everyday lunch.
seoTitle: Bun mam — fermented pork noodles in Da Nang
seoDescription: Bun mam thit heo is Da Nang’s fermented-fish noodle with boiled pork. Order it at lunch at Ba Van on Tran Ke Xuong, and skip it if that broth is not yours.
